title: Black Cat musicians scatter; he joins Edgar Hayes
summary: After almost a year at the Black Cat, with Freddie Green, Bobby Moore and Frank Clarke gone, Clarke joined Edgar Hayes late in 1936.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Then, after being with Edgar for -- I joined them in 1936, right after I left the Black Cat.
Because I stayed there almost a year. And then, after Freddie left, then everybody became uneasy.
And Frank, he joined Buddy Johnson's band.
Uh-huh. And Bobby joined Basie and --
: Yeah. And Freddie had joined Basie.
Freddie joined Basie, and after, as Atkins, the a piano player, he went back to Philadelphia, and Lonny went to Chicago to play organ.
(Unintelligible) -- and then all of a sudden everybody's all over the corners of the earth.
And I joined Edgar Hayes' band around the latter part of that year, and --
